rows.name: f_saxpy
rows.task: y[i] = a*x[i] + y[i] in f32, fused, rounded once to nearest

rows.name: f_axpy_nofma
rows.task: y[i] = a*x[i] + y[i] in f32 with a separately rounded product

rows.name: f_scale_ftz
rows.task: y[i] = x[i] * a in f32 with subnormals flushed to zero

rows.name: f_relu
rows.task: y[i] = max(x[i], 0) in f32 (a NaN input gives 0)

rows.name: f_clamp01
rows.task: y[i] = x[i] clamped to [0, 1], NaN to 0, in f32

rows.name: f_abs
rows.task: y[i] = |x[i]| in f32

rows.name: f_negsub
rows.task: z[i] = -x[i] - y[i] in f32, rounded to nearest

rows.name: f_sqrt
rows.task: y[i] = sqrt(x[i]) in f32, correctly rounded

rows.name: f_div
rows.task: z[i] = x[i] / y[i] in f32, correctly rounded

rows.name: f_recip
rows.task: y[i] = 1 / x[i] in f32, correctly rounded

rows.name: f_lerp
rows.task: c[i] = a[i] + t*(b[i] - a[i]) in f32, the product and sum fused

rows.name: f_min3
rows.task: d[i] = min(a[i], b[i], c[i]) in f32 (NaN inputs ignored)

rows.name: f_horner
rows.task: y[i] = c0 + x[i]*(c1 + x[i]*c2) in f32 by two fmas

rows.name: f_maxnan
rows.task: z[i] = max(x[i], y[i]) in f32, NaN if either is NaN

rows.name: f_add_rz
rows.task: z[i] = x[i] + y[i] in f32, rounded toward zero

rows.name: f_saxpy_stride
rows.task: y[i] = a*x[i] + y[i] in f32, fused, grid-stride loop
